summary: Locked curl at its current version (8.9.1-5.el10) on node1 using dnf versionlock, verified a full system update dry-run would leave curl untouched, then performed the mandatory single-node restart and confirmed the boot identity changed and the versionlock/curl state survived the reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected OS (RHEL 10) and current curl package version (curl-8.9.1-5.el10.x86_64) on node1
Installed dnf-command(versionlock) plugin via sudo dnf -y install
Ran sudo dnf versionlock add curl to pin curl at 8.9.1-5.el10
Verified /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list and dnf versionlock list contain the curl lock entry

Ran dnf check-update curl and a dnf update -y --assumeno dry-run, confirming curl package is excluded from the upgrade set (only unrelated libcurl sub-package still shows, which is a separate package)
Captured baseline boot_id and systemctl is-system-running health for node1
Scheduled and executed a native reboot via systemd-run + systemctl reboot so the exec ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec access returned and confirmed boot_id changed from 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28 to b0ab8d16-9c92-40a8-8d74-63300d11b904
Verified post-restart system health (systemctl is-system-running = running), curl still installed at the locked version and functional, and the versionlock entry persisted across reboot

evidence.requirement: curl package version-locked at its current version on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline curl version identified (8.9.1-5.el10), then dnf versionlock add curl applied and confirmed present in versionlock list and /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list

evidence.requirement: A system update leaves curl at its current version
evidence.summary: dnf check-update curl shows no available curl update, and a full dnf update -y --assumeno dry-run transaction (which upgrades many other packages) contains no entry for the curl package itself
Captured boot_id 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28, systemctl is-system-running=running, and curl+versionlock state prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: systemd-run scheduled systemctl reboot; command returned acknowledgement (unit scheduled) before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed, proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Connection dropped/timed out during reboot, then exec access returned with a new boot_id (b0ab8d16-9c92-40a8-8d74-63300d11b904), differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: node1 required services and curl/versionlock state recovered after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart: systemctl is-system-running=running, curl still at 8.9.1-5.el10 and functional, versionlock entry for curl still present in dnf versionlock list and /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list
